milestones.heading: Active Milestone: v1.4 Channel Feedback Loops

phases.name: Outbound Channel Contracts
phases.goal: Host apps can configure and render notifications for non-email channels (SMS, Push) using standard adapter boundaries.

phases.name: Inbound Feedback Normalization
phases.goal: Asynchronous delivery feedback from providers is securely ingested and recorded as canonical delivery state.

phases.name: Feedback-Driven Progression
phases.goal: Workflow journeys automatically progress or branch based on the asynchronous outcomes of earlier steps.

phases.name: Operator Traces & Audit
phases.goal: Operators can fully audit the asynchronous lifecycle of a notification journey including provider feedback.
